_about: Optional finished decor images (docs/image-prompts.md section E). Put the PNG here (or in design/incoming/ while testing); missing files fall back to the code-drawn SVG. crop = [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the source image; key_white makes the white background transparent; px = longest side after processing. Kept: the moon portrait frame and the cloud wash; the polaroids, doodles and paper stay code-drawn (they looked better, 2026-10-03).
